manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.population: 16 fresh complete operational mappings balanced as {'predicate-empty': 8, 'search-empty': 8}
manifest.selection: Eight immutable scopes and positive predicates were frozen before tokenizer import and crossed with both forms. Each English comparator is the source's complete meaning and exclusion template.
manifest.method: Compute Ainglish minus complete-English tokens for every pair under each pinned encoding; average within each form stratum, weight form strata equally, and report the least-favourable encoding mean.

estimand.population: the 16 fresh complete pairs retained in this manifest
estimand.aggregation: equal form-stratum mean per tokenizer; headline is the maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.comparator: the source's complete careful-English mapping, never bare or abbreviated English
estimand.interpretation: token cost only; no claim about comprehension, fidelity, scope adequacy, or adoption

manifest.freeze: The server retains these canonical manifest bytes before prior-input retrieval and before this process imports tiktoken or observes a token count.
